indicator_definition: Proportion of municipal waste that is recycled, expressed as a percentage of total waste generated. Covers material recycling and composting. Data compiled by Eurostat from national waste statistics.
rationale: Increasing recycling reduces landfilling and resource extraction. Progress means an increasing share of municipal waste being recycled.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled by Eurostat from national waste statistics under the Waste Statistics Regulation. Includes material recycling and composting. Published annually.
